page_contract: 同一场雨落到五种城市表面后，会沿由表面结构决定的路径快速径流、穿缝下渗、根区滞留、基质截留或绕行缓释。

author_layer.counting_rule: UTF-8 decoded characters in the complete authored runtime source; frozen runtime dependencies are excluded.

author_files.origin: The exact controller and shader behavior previously embedded in the one-line index.html, rewritten as readable-compact source.

chars.decision: The increase is the explicit cost of removing one-line minification, replacing opaque host identifiers with semantic names, formatting the GLSL mechanism, and making ownership inspectable. At 16,702 readable characters, this full version will need a separate mini if selected as an auxiliary sample.

readability_changes: Separated semantic HTML, one-selector-per-line CSS and the renderer/controller into three bounded files.
Named the five-state controller, scroll target, hover/detail state, renderer resources, texture pairs and lifecycle ownership directly.
Formatted and semantically named the shader's hash, noise, field, warp, path mask and texture roles without changing operation order or constants.
Exposed a small deterministic API for state inspection, exact reset, fixed-time rendering and disposal without adding visible controls.
Added no-pan to the authored pointer surface so the already-authored swipe route works with real browser touch input rather than being cancelled as page panning.
Guarded public mutations after disposal and disposed textures that finish loading after pagehide.
Centralized WebGL ownership so partial texture-load and mid-initialization failures release every texture and any renderer, material or geometry already created.

states: 1600x900 reduced initial, hover/path reveal, detail and last wheel position
1600x900 fixed normal hover/path frame at t=2000

tests.name: fixed-state visual equivalence
tests.evidence: All nine final baseline/candidate PNG pairs are byte-identical or RGB AE=0; deterministic normal hover proves the active shader path, not only the zero-progress frame.

tests.name: WebGL, shader and semantic state
tests.evidence: At the third-surface hover state, the normalized DOM, five materials, ten textures, one geometry, draw/triangle counts, mouse vectors and [0,0,1,0,0] path uniforms produced the same SHA256 in baseline and candidate.

tests.name: isolated input routes
tests.evidence: Keyboard navigation, wheel, mouse hover, focus, click-open, Escape-close, close-button, reset and synthetic touch-pointer swipe settled to identical baseline/candidate DOM-state hashes. Rapid key input also reached the same final inline state after compositor settlement.

tests.name: real touch
tests.evidence: A real CDP touch swipe advances exactly one 580-unit surface in the candidate. Adding the chassis no-pan contract prevents the baseline's intended pointer route from being cancelled by browser panning; no mouse or click behavior changed.

tests.name: reduced motion and deterministic animation
tests.evidence: Reduced motion resolves scroll, surface geometry, opacity and path reveal immediately. Mock-clock normal animation through t=2000 retained exact interpolation and animated shader pixels.

tests.name: resize and overflow
tests.evidence: 1600x900 and 1280x720 retain the 1600x900 logical stage, exact state geometry and viewport-equal scroll bounds with no clipping escape.

tests.name: fallback
tests.evidence: Forced WebGL initialization failure leaves all five source SVG cards visible; baseline and candidate fallback screenshots are AE=0. The expected Three.js context warning is the only console error in this forced branch. An independent partial texture-failure branch now also proves all ten allocated textures are disposed and the SVG fallback remains visible.

tests.name: dispose and reload
tests.evidence: pagehide cancels RAF, unregisters resize/input, disposes five materials, ten textures, shared geometry and renderer, and marks ready=false. All public mutations are no-ops after disposal; reload restores one canvas, five images, five surfaces and canonical index 0.

tests.name: runtime resources
tests.evidence: Normal, reduced, interaction, resize and lifecycle runs have zero page errors, console errors and failed requests. Every relative symlink resolves.

rejected_compression.proposal: Keep the HTML, CSS, controller or GLSL on one line.
rejected_compression.reason: That reproduces the exact Agent-readability defect this pass is intended to remove.

rejected_compression.proposal: Restore one-letter host variables or anonymous positional state arrays.
rejected_compression.reason: This would lower character count by hiding renderer ownership and the causal surface/path state model.

rejected_compression.proposal: Remove the inspection API, fallback, touch contract, reset or explicit disposal paths.
rejected_compression.reason: Each is necessary for learnability, input coverage or lifecycle correctness.

notes: The formal archive remains hash-identical and the candidate was not promoted.
The readable full source exceeds the original sub-10k minified character count; mini eligibility must therefore use the improved full size, not the misleading minified baseline size.

cross_audit.revision: The prior forced-fallback test covered WebGLRenderer construction failure but not a texture request failing after other textures had already allocated. Instrumentation reproduced fallback=true with zero texture disposals. The staging candidate now tracks in-flight textures and routes successful initialization, partial loading failure, mid-build failure and pagehide through explicit ownership cleanup.
cross_audit.readability: Readable-compact: semantic HTML, CSS, renderer ownership, five-surface scene state and formatted GLSL are separated without minification. The longest authored line is a compact CSS selector group; JavaScript remains at or below 115 characters per line. The resource fix adds one named releaseGraphics path instead of duplicating teardown logic.

independent_evidence.normal_shader: surface 3 fixed at t=2000 produced progress [0,0,1,0,0]
independent_evidence.lifecycle: pagehide made a cached API inert, released 10 textures, 5 materials, 1 geometry, 1 renderer and 1 WebGL context exactly once; reload restored one canvas
independent_evidence.partial_failure: forced third texture failure disposed all 10 allocated textures and retained all five visible source SVG cards
independent_evidence.selfcheck: Original selfcheck ran initial, last-surface and detail states without runtime or request errors; its reported horizontal rail clipping is the authored overflow viewport, not clipped evidence or text overlap.

cross_audit.symlink_and_http: Baseline pages and candidate assets/media symlinks resolve to the unchanged formal tree and served successfully over HTTP with no unexpected request failures.
cross_audit.remaining_risk: The continuous WebGL shader remains GPU-dependent; deterministic equivalence is therefore anchored by reduced-mode pixels, fixed shader state, canonical uniforms and resource counts rather than assuming cross-GPU raster identity.
